rule: Choose the playbook for the requested task. Dataset audits are read-only and need no X token. Live account retrieval requires authorization. Check the operator's own draft before publishing. Preserve disclosures and evidence; do not ask the user to read this repo.

playbooks.when: Find the operator's post records in the public dataset and, when authorized access is available, match exact IDs from their API, browser, or archive.
